appearanceMeaning: Original public native onAppear callback; mounted context only, never a per-modifier semantic pass.

steps: Read native accessibility value of generated-accessibility-value: Allowance 7
Tap Increase modifier allowance
Read same native element value: Allowance 8
observableSequences.separateCompanionAction: Generated accessibility action produces MODIFIER_ACCESSIBILITY_ACTIONS:1; this does not verify VoiceOver/direct-touch behavior.

steps: Read native frame of generated-position-text and width of generated-tracking-text
Tap Change modifier geometry
Position center X increases by 120 points; tracked text width increases; MODIFIER_GEOMETRY_STATE:changed
observableSequences.tolerance: Native layout rounding tolerance is acceptable; compare actual before/after frames, not the JS state marker alone.

steps: Tap physical center of generated-hit-front while disabled; expect MODIFIER_HIT_COUNTS:front=0;back=1
Tap Enable generated front target
Tap same target center; expect MODIFIER_HIT_COUNTS:front=1;back=1
observableSequences.reason: Two real native buttons occupy the same ZStack; the actual receiving button increments its own event count.

steps: Type into native generated-modifier-input and verify MODIFIER_INPUT matches the complete text
Press native return while blocked; expect MODIFIER_SUBMITS:0
Tap Allow generated submit; refocus field and press native return
Expect MODIFIER_SUBMITS:1
observableSequences.reason: Ancestor original onSubmit handler receives native submission; no JS test event invokes it.

steps: Tap Generated selectable row in actual native List edit mode while selection is disabled
Expect MODIFIER_LIST_SELECTION:none
Tap Allow generated selection and tap the row again
Expect MODIFIER_LIST_SELECTION:invoice
observableSequences.reason: Modifier is on the real tagged row, not the Table container.

steps: Observe native Generated item header and Generated amount header
Tap Toggle generated headers
Headers are hidden; actual data rows remain
observableSequences.boundary: Use native header element observation and screenshot; do not infer from an unrelated state label.

steps: Open Generated search context and focus original native search field
Tap Generated suggestion Isaiah
Expect complete MODIFIER_SEARCH_QUERY:Isaiah
observableSequences.boundary: searchSuggestions content/menu policy is separately forwarded; completion must come from the native suggestion interaction.

steps: Observe Generated native title in native navigation bar
Toggle generated navigation bar and observe hidden/restored bar
Open generated detail; native back is hidden
Tap Show generated native back; back is restored
Return via actual native back or Close generated detail
observableSequences.boundary: Additional subtitle/link-indicator forwarding is not proven solely by navigation success.

additionalContextInteractions: Swipe Generated swipe row and trigger Record generated swipe; native action count increments
Open generated inspector, observe real inspector content, then controlled close; width is a layout observation only if the OS uses a column
Adjust real native Slider and observe callback value; label/thumb visual effects require actual visible inspection
unestablishedFullEffects: Xcode previewDisplayName runtime effect is inapplicable
Document launch title/subtitle requires actual host-owned DocumentLaunchView/scene
File-dialog option/label/message/customization/alias behavior requires a real SwiftUI file importer/exporter presenter
Accessibility speech/direct-touch, large-content viewer and drag/drop point effects require their OS service/context
Inactive-window activation, Assistive Access, system gestures/status/overlays, external URL preference and RTL flipping require corresponding OS conditions
validationOwner: entrypoints; one combined actual original SDK/compiler/public CLI validation and Metro build after current facade metadata fix

modeSynchronization.Enable generated front target: Wait for native button label Generated front target enabled before repeating the physical target tap.
modeSynchronization.Allow generated submit: Wait for native button label Generated submit allowed before Return.
modeSynchronization.Allow generated selection: Wait for native button label Generated selection allowed before tapping the tagged row.
